title: OpenUtau: free VOCALOID alternative
caption:
VOCALOID7 Editor costs $129. OpenUtau lets you make a virtual singer sing your song for free 🎤

✅ Type notes and lyrics in a piano roll and a virtual singer sings them
✅ Draw pitch curves and vibrato to make the voice sound real
✅ Auto-converts lyrics for English, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Russian and more
✅ Opens UST, VSQX and MIDI projects, exports your vocals as audio

💻 Windows · Mac · Linux
ℹ️ OpenUtau doesn't come with a voice: you install a singer (voicebank) yourself, made by the community, so check each one's terms. The newest builds are tagged alpha, and the Mac build is Apple Silicon only. VOCALOID7's $129 is the Editor with one included voice, before tax

Comment "SING" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
